summary: Seeded-failure results; the implementer ran them only locally, and so did I, on a throwaway worktree at 344527ef. (1) An unpinned `actions/checkout@v7` in pr-guard.yml makes the safety script exit 1, naming both lines. (2) The rustc check step, run with the pin set to 1.98.0 against rustc 1.99.1, exits 1 with `::error::`. (3) Man generator: `cargo check` and the release build compile the same target, so a compile error fails both by construction; not run in CI. CI: all 10 Rust jobs log rustc 1.99.1 at cbfb7db7 and 344527ef. PR Guard has no paths filter. The only red job is `canon gate check` (review backlog and ci re-evidence), not a CI definition. Judgment: local runs of the same commands meet the Check's intent; a CI run on a throwaway branch was not done.
